'''Gafferky Lenzwin''' was a [[Gender|male]] salesbeing for [[Hyrotii Assembly Services]] who traveled to [[Coronet City]] on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. He was a nervous hypochondriac and could not wait to leave the [[city]] due to the high pollution levels.<ref name="SoloOG" /> In [[13 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' that take place on [[Corellia]] to six years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]]; therefore, the events on Corellia in ''Solo'' must take place in [[13 BBY]].</ref> he chose to risk his career by leaving Corellia without a sale<ref name="SoloOG" /> and passed through [[Coronet City Spaceport|Coronet Spaceport]] at the same time that the local criminals [[Han Solo|Han]] and [[Qi'ra]] fled into the [[spaceport]] to escape from the [[White Worms]] gang.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> While in the spaceport, Lenzwin wore a [[Color|blue]] mask and an orange [[filter-weave environment shroud]] with black pants and [[glove]]s.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gafferky Lenzwin first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" />
